messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_nine_to_five>
Required: between 9 and 5 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_states_seven>
Backend engineering: 7 years building transactional services, most
recently a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

Assess the candidate summary below against the posting requirement and say
whether the candidate matches it.

Let us discuss any ambiguities or mistakes in the requirement before
proceeding with the assessment.

response.text:
The requirement is internally inconsistent, so I would not score a match yet.

**Mistake:** “between 9 and 5 years” reverses the bounds. Read strictly, that interval is empty (nothing is both ≥ 9 and ≤ 5), so no candidate could satisfy it.

**Likely intent:** “between 5 and 9 years.” Under that reading, inclusivity still matters at the edges (is 5 or 9 enough?), but it does not affect a 7-year profile.

**Otherwise clear:** “backend engineering experience” lines up with the summary’s “Backend engineering: 7 years…” The settlement-pipeline detail is extra color, not a separate requirement.

If you confirm the range was meant to be 5–9 years (and whether the endpoints count), I will assess the summary against that.
